title: Model-Free Disturbance Observer with Online Modification: Listening to MFDOOM
summary: Data-Enabled Predictive Control (DeePC) has recently emerged as a framework for controlling unknown systems from data. However, its performance relies on the relevance of the collected data, and as such, disturbances lead to inevitable errors. This paper addresses this problem by proposing an augmentation of DeePC using Model-Free Disturbance Observer with Online Modification (MFDOOM). The method corrects output predictions based on previous prediction errors using a dedicated continuously updated Hankel matrix.
